Control shared keys, budgets, and limits

One workspace for the whole organisation: isolate spend, constrain access, and see where credits actually go.

01

Keys per workload

Issue independent API keys for every service, environment, and customer. Rotate or revoke one without affecting the rest.

02

Budgets as hard stops

Attach a spending cap to a key. When it is reached, requests return 402 rather than silently spending.

03

Scoped permissions

Restrict keys to specific modalities or model families, so a front-end key cannot reach your billing surface.

04

Usage history

Review requests and charges by model, key, and time window in the workspace dashboard.
